title: epidat – Datenbank zur jüdischen Grabsteinepigraphik
institution: Salomon Ludwig Steinheim-Institut für deutsch-jüdische Geschichte (Essen), with the Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur | Mainz
license_note: Each EpiDoc record states CC BY 4.0; the site footer states CC BY 4.0 as well.
notes: Jewish gravestone inscriptions (322 digital editions, 54,243 monuments on the site; monuments after 1956 withheld). EpiDoc TEI per monument (?id=<code>-teip5) and bulk in the public GitLab repository (xml/tei, tsv, json, ttl). The vast majority of the corpus is 18th-20th century. The in-period inscriptions are concentrated in Frankfurt (ffb 864), Hamburg-Altona (hha 270) and Worms (wrm 251). The older site interface is no longer developed; a beta interface exists. Repository last activity 2026-08-13. Inscriptions without a parseable year are not counted, and the transcriptions mix Hebrew with a German or Latin-script rendering, so word counts are approximate. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
